summary: I wish all this talk about CBE and skills at #ASUSGSV2918 would take a lesson from 30 years of reading research and realize teaching skills does little without knowledge. We know we can teach decoding that's easy. Doesn't make a better reader alone.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I wish all this talk about CBE and skills at #ASUSGSV2918 would take a lesson from 30 years of reading research and realize teaching skills does little without knowledge.

We know we can teach decoding that's easy. Doesn't make a better reader alone.
